verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is documented as a data exchange platform for securely sharing, discovering, and accessing data across organizational boundaries without replicating it. Listings let you share without copying and can be monetized on Google Cloud Marketplace, and IAM roles apply at the dataset level. This directly covers zero-copy cross-org sharing with no export pipeline. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-org sharing, and explicit documentation of live freshness and subscriber-side mechanics beyond intro-level statements.
